title: 3dDeconvolve
description: Program to calculate the deconvolution of a measurement 3D+time dataset with a specified input stimulus time series.

num_stimts.description: Number of input stimulus time series.
num_stimts.title: Number of Stimulus Time Series

stim_file.description: Filename of kth time series input stimulus.
stim_file.title: Stimulus File

stim_base.description: Kth input stimulus is part of the baseline model.
stim_base.title: Stimulus Baseline

stim_times.description: Deconvolution response model for kth stimulus.
stim_times.title: Stimulus Times

iresp.description: Prefix for 3D+time output dataset which will contain the kth estimated impulse response.
iresp.title: Estimated Impulse Response

fitts.description: Prefix for 3D+time output dataset which will contain the (full model) time series fit to the input data.
fitts.title: Fitted Time Series

fout.description: Flag to output the F-statistics for each stimulus.
fout.title: Output F-Statistics

bucket.description: Create one AFNI 'bucket' dataset containing various parameters of interest.
bucket.title: Bucket Dataset

cbucket.description: Save the regression coefficients (no statistics) into a dataset.
cbucket.title: Coefficient Bucket

x1D.description: Save X matrix to a .xmat.1D (ASCII) file.
x1D.title: X-Matrix Output

jobs.description: Run the program with multiple jobs (sub-processes).
jobs.title: Number of Jobs
